issues.description: The Microsoft Designer bullet omits the caveat from the KB that some Designer features (and generated content examples) apply only to private Microsoft accounts.
issues.required_fix: Add a short note that some Designer features/usage conditions are limited to private Microsoft accounts and cite kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_51_1.

issues.description: The Minecraft Education bullet recommends using Hour of Code worlds but does not mention the licensing note in the KB that some worlds/content are part of the school paid license (Microsoft 365 A3/A5).
issues.required_fix: Add the licensing caveat that while some Hour of Code worlds are free, other Minecraft Education content may require a Microsoft 365 A3/A5 school licence and cite kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_15_2.

issues.description: Practical hour plan is labeled as 'general background knowledge' which is consistent, but the section does not reference the recommended iterative workflow and pilot/testing guidance from the earlier chapter (3-1), which would improve alignment.
issues.required_fix: Add one sentence linking this quick lesson outline to the 'Doporučený časový workflow (tvorba artefaktu)' / piloting recommendation from section 3-1 (internal memory) so teachers are reminded to define objectives and pilot the activity.

issues.description: The quick lesson skeleton gives time boxes but no concrete example learning objective or expected student artefact.
issues.required_fix: Include one brief example learning objective and the expected student artefact (e.g., short reflective note, generated image used in worksheet, or short group presentation) to make the plan directly actionable.

issues.description: Footnotes are present and valid, but the final enumerate footnote is generic 'General background knowledge' in English; consider using consistent Czech phrasing for footnotes.
issues.required_fix: Change the English 'General background knowledge' footnote text to the Czech equivalent used elsewhere (e.g., 'General background knowledge' → 'Obecné doplňující informace') or keep format consistent with other footnotes.

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: After the existing sentence add: 'Upozornění: některé světy v rámci Minecraft Education jsou volně dostupné v Hour of Code, ale další obsahy mohou být součástí školní placené licence Microsoft 365 A3/A5.' Cite kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_15_2.
Add a short caveat sentence such as: 'Pozn.: některé funkce nebo podmínky použití mohou být omezeny na soukromé Microsoft účty.' Cite kb_ai_101_tipu_pdf_page_51_1.

Insert one concrete example learning objective and expected artefact, e.g.: 'Cíl hodiny: studenti vysvětlí základní principy strojového učení a vypracují krátkou reflexi (max. 200 slov) o tom, jak se model v daném Minecraft světě učí.' Label this example explicitly and keep the original time boxes.

Add a short linker sentence to the beginning or end of the enumerate: 'Tuto kostru použijte v rámci doporučeného iterativního workflow: nejprve definujte cíl a očekávané výstupy, pilotujte aktivitu na malé skupině a upravte podle zpětné vazby.' This aligns with the workflow in section 3-1 (internal memory).
Use consistent Czech phrasing for the general background footnote (e.g., replace 'General background knowledge' with a Czech label consistent with other footnotes in the document).
